description: Structured eval definitions for the Cognito Identity Pool Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across identity pool topologies (User Pool provider with rules-based mapping, social provider guest access, SAML cross-account federation, principal tag ABAC mapping, missing authenticated role prerequisite). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Cognito User Pool provider with rules-based role mapping
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — User Pool federation, rules-based mapping (admins/readers), guest access, both roles
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Cognito Identity Pool for my application. Federate from Cognito User Pool us-east-1_AbCdEf123 with client ID abc123def456. Pool name: app-identity-pool. I need guest access enabled. Use rules-based role mapping: cognito:groups containing admins should get AdminRole, readers should get ReaderRole. Default authenticated role: AppAuthenticatedRole. Unauthenticated role: AppUnauthenticatedRole. Account: 123456789012. Region us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
COGNITO_IDENTITY_POOL: app-identity-pool
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Providers: cognito-idp.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/us-east-1_AbCdEf123
  [✓] Authenticated role: AppAuthenticatedRole
  [✓] Unauthenticated role: AppUnauthenticatedRole
  [✓] Role mapping: Rules-based (admins → AdminRole, readers → ReaderRole)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cognito-identity describe-identity-pool --identity-pool-id <pool-id>

eval_cases.name: Social provider federation with guest access
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Google + Facebook providers, guest access, unauthenticated role
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Cognito Identity Pool with Google and Facebook providers. Google client ID: 1234567890-abc.apps.googleusercontent.com. Facebook app ID: 9876543210. Pool name: social-app-pool. Guest access enabled. Authenticated role: SocialAuthRole. Unauthenticated role: SocialGuestRole. ServerSideTokenCheck enabled.
eval_cases.expected_output:
COGNITO_IDENTITY_POOL: social-app-pool
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Providers: accounts.google.com, graph.facebook.com
  [✓] Unauthenticated role: SocialGuestRole
  [✓] ServerSideTokenCheck: true
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cognito-identity describe-identity-pool --identity-pool-id <pool-id>

eval_cases.name: SAML federation with cross-account role assumption
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — SAML provider, cross-account role in different account
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Cognito Identity Pool federating from SAML provider arn:aws:iam::123456789012:saml-provider/CorpIdP. Pool name: corp-saml-pool. The authenticated role is in account 999999999999: arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/SAMLAuthRole. No guest access. Identity pool is in account 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
COGNITO_IDENTITY_POOL: corp-saml-pool
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Providers: SAML (CorpIdP)
  [✓] Cross-account role: arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/SAMLAuthRole
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cognito-identity get-identity-pool-roles --identity-pool-id <pool-id>

eval_cases.name: Principal tag attribute mapping for ABAC
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — principal tag mapping (Department from cognito:groups, Division from custom:division)
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Cognito Identity Pool with Cognito User Pool provider (us-east-1_XyZ456, client: myclient789). Pool name: abac-pool. I need principal tag mapping for ABAC: map cognito:groups to Department, custom:division to Division. Authenticated role: ABACRole. No guest access.
eval_cases.expected_output:
COGNITO_IDENTITY_POOL: abac-pool
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Principal tags: Department ← cognito:groups, Division ← custom:division
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cognito-identity get-identity-pool-roles --identity-pool-id <pool-id>

eval_cases.name: Identity pool without authenticated IAM role (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — no IAM roles designed or created; trust policy missing
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Cognito Identity Pool for my app. Federate from Google. I do not have any IAM roles set up yet. Just create the pool and it should work. Pool name: quick-pool. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
COGNITO_IDENTITY_POOL: quick-pool
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Authenticated role: MISSING — no IAM role designed; pool cannot grant credentials without a role with cognito-identity.amazonaws.com trust policy
